simple.meaning: מַצָּבָה (matstsâbâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a military guard.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Samuel 14:12. The surrounding context includes family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַצָּבָה (H4675) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
